en.name: Vegetable soup, homemade
en.summary: Home-made vegetable soup keeps 3–4 days in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Cooling the pot fast is what makes those days real.
en.pantry: A big pot of soup is one of the slowest-cooling things a kitchen produces, and leaving it on the hob to come down in its own time keeps the middle in the danger zone between 4 and 60 °C for hours. Ladle it into shallow containers within two hours of cooking, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F). A cold-water bath in the sink, with the pot standing in it and the soup stirred occasionally, cuts that time down dramatically for a large batch. Do not put a hot stockpot straight into the fridge — it warms everything around it.
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in covered shallow containers. Let them cool uncovered or loosely covered until cold, then seal, so condensation does not drip back into the soup. Vegetable soup with beans, barley, pasta or potato in it sits at the short end of that range, because those are cooked starches. Reheat only the portion you are eating, to a rolling boil, and do not warm the same portion a second time.
en.freezer: 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze in meal-sized portions in flat bags laid on a tray until solid, leaving headspace because liquid expands. Potato goes mealy and pasta goes mushy, so if you make a minestrone for the freezer, freeze the base and add the pasta or potato when you reheat. Leafy greens and courgette soften considerably; root vegetables and pulses survive well.
en.thawing: Reheat straight from frozen in a covered pan over low heat, or thaw in the fridge overnight, then bring it to a rolling boil. Never thaw on the counter.
spoilage: A sour, yeasty or fermented smell when the lid comes off.
Bubbles or fizzing in cold soup, or a lid that has domed.
A slimy or ropy texture in the liquid.
Mould on the surface, or vegetables that have gone grey and disintegrated.
tips: Ladle into shallow containers to cool; never refrigerate the whole pot.
Cool a big batch in a cold-water bath in the sink first.
Freeze the base and add pasta or potato at the reheating stage.
Freeze flat in bags so portions stack and thaw quickly.

faq.q: How long does homemade vegetable soup keep?
faq.a: 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in covered shallow containers.
Yes, 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze it flat in portions with headspace, and add pasta or potato when you reheat.

faq.q: Can you leave soup out overnight to cool?
faq.a: No. A big pot holds heat in the middle for hours. Divide it into shallow containers and refrigerate within two hours.

zh.name: 自製蔬菜湯
zh.summary: 自製蔬菜湯冷藏 4 °C 以下可放 3～4 天，冷凍 −18 °C 下 3 個月。讓這幾天真正成立的，是你把整鍋降溫得多快。
zh.pantry: 一大鍋湯是廚房裡降溫最慢的東西之一，留在爐上讓它自己慢慢涼，等於讓鍋子中心在 4 到 60 °C 的危險溫度帶待上好幾個小時。請在煮好後兩小時內把湯舀進淺容器，氣溫超過 32 °C 時縮短為一小時。份量大的話，把鍋子放進裝冷水的水槽、不時攪拌，能把降溫時間大幅縮短。也不要把滾燙的湯鍋直接塞進冰箱——它會把周圍的東西一起加溫。
zh.fridge: 加蓋淺容器放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天。先不蓋或鬆蓋，等冷透再密封，冷凝水才不會滴回湯裡。加了豆子、大麥、義大利麵或馬鈴薯的蔬菜湯請取期限的短端，因為那些是熟澱粉。要吃多少熱多少，並且煮到滾沸；同一份不要再熱第二次。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 3 個月。請分成一餐的份量裝進扁平袋，平放在托盤上凍硬，並留下膨脹空間，因為液體會脹。馬鈴薯會變粉、義大利麵會糊，所以如果是為冷凍而煮的義式蔬菜湯，請只冷凍湯底，麵或馬鈴薯留到回熱時再加。葉菜和櫛瓜會明顯變軟，根莖類和豆類則撐得很好。
zh.thawing: 直接從冷凍加蓋小火回熱，或放冷藏隔夜解凍，再煮到滾沸。不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 掀蓋就聞到酸味、酵母味或發酵味。
冷湯冒泡或有氣泡感，或盒蓋鼓起。
表面長霉，或蔬菜整個發灰崩解。
tips: 舀進淺容器降溫，絕對不要整鍋冰。
大份量先用水槽冷水浴降溫。
只冷凍湯底，麵和馬鈴薯回熱時再加。
裝袋平放冷凍，好疊也快解凍。

faq.q: 自製蔬菜湯可以放多久？
faq.a: 加蓋淺容器放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 3 個月。分份平放冷凍並留膨脹空間，麵或馬鈴薯回熱時再加。

faq.q: 整鍋湯可以放外面涼一整晚嗎？
faq.a: 不行。大鍋中心會溫好幾個小時。請分裝進淺容器並在兩小時內冷藏。
